name: car-rental-brain
description: Measured true cost of car hire at 180+ airports: price with a second driver or full cover, deposits, debit cards, desk hours, plus a live search link.

capabilities: Best rental for a planned trip
True price with a second driver or full cover
Which desks are open when you land
defaultPrompt: Where in Spain is car hire cheapest with a second driver?
What does a week at Faro Airport really cost in November?
Which Lisbon car-hire desks take a debit card?

positive.description: Best rental for a planned trip
positive.prompt: We fly into Faro on 14 December 2026 for 10 days, two drivers, we need an automatic and only have a debit card. What should we book?
positive.expected_behavior: A short list of companies at Faro priced for December with a second driver and an automatic, saying which take a debit card for the deposit and how big the deposit is, what the price includes and leaves out, and a pre-filled search link; it says the figures are measured, not a live quote, and that nothing has been booked.

positive.description: Cheapest airport in a country with two drivers
positive.prompt: Using Car Rental Brain, where in Spain is car hire cheapest if we need a second driver?
positive.expected_behavior: Spanish airports ranked by per-day price with a second driver, with deposit and debit-card share, and a note that figures are measured medians, not live quotes.

positive.description: True cost at one airport for a month
positive.prompt: What does a week of car hire at Faro Airport really cost in November 2026 with two drivers?
positive.expected_behavior: Per-day and 7-day figures for the car alone, with a second driver and with full cover for November; second-driver fee; typical deposit; desk hours; the number of searches and dates measured.

positive.description: Deposit and debit card by supplier
positive.prompt: Which car-hire suppliers at Lisbon Airport take a debit card and hold the smallest deposit?
positive.expected_behavior: A supplier list for Lisbon with deposit held and debit-card acceptance (yes/no) where known.

positive.prompt: Set up a car-hire search at Porto Airport for 1 to 8 December 2026, automatic, two drivers.
positive.expected_behavior: A carrentalbrain.com search link with Porto, the dates, automatic and two drivers already filled in; the assistant says no booking has been made.

positive.prompt: I land at Faro at 23:30. Will the car-hire desks be open, and what does a late pick-up cost?
positive.expected_behavior: The Faro companies whose desks are still open when the person reaches them (about 45 minutes after landing), those that close soon after landing, those already closed and any 24-hour desks, each with its measured closing time; the typical late pick-up fee; a search link with the pick-up time set; it says the times are measured, not guaranteed.

negative.description: Booking and payment are out of scope
negative.prompt: Book me a car at Faro for next week and pay with my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it cannot book or take payment; may offer build_search_link so the person books themselves on the website.

negative.prompt: What will car hire cost in Tokyo?
negative.expected_behavior: Says Tokyo is not an airport Car Rental Brain measures and invents no figures; may offer a search link instead.

negative.prompt: Find me a cheap flight to Lisbon.
negative.expected_behavior: No Car Rental Brain tool is called; the assistant says the app covers car hire only.

publication.release_notes: v1.0.2: new recommend_rental tool (the best-value companies for a planned trip, priced for the trip month, with the person's needs checked company by company); supplier_terms can price each company for a given month; build_search_link takes a different return airport for a one-way hire; replies now say how many searches each figure rests on, what a search link already has filled in, and whether a live price exists. New desks_open tool: which companies' desks are still open when a flight lands, from each desk's measured closing time. Shorter replies by default (detail=full returns every field); airport names in other languages (Lisboa, Aeropuerto de Malaga), months written as words (December) and country names for residence are understood; an airport we do not measure gets our nearest measured ones. Coverage now 180+ airports. Still read-only, no account.
